'''Star Tours Flight 1010''' was the designation of a [[Star Tours/Legends|Star Tours]] travel agency flight to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. On the day of the [[Raid at Spaceport THX1138]], it was stationed at the spaceport's Gate 1H, and its status was on time with an estimated departure time of 1415 hours.
